**Scope**
This data dictionary defines all registry variables required to support diabetes surveillance, quality-of-care metrics, and service planning in St Helena. All variables are either:

- Routinely recorded during 6-monthly diabetes clinic visits, or
- Directly derivable from PatientSource (EMR) without additional bespoke data collection.

------

## 2. Diabetes Diagnosis & Status (was Diagnosis)

| In REDCap  | Variable (short name) | Label (long name)                                            | Field type  | Coding                               | Required   |
| ---------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------- |
| dm         | diabetes_status       | Diagnosed diabetes (==change responses==)                    | binary      | 0=No, 1=Pre-diabetes, 2=Diabetes     | y          |
| —          | diabetes_type         | Diabetes type                                                | categorical | 1=T1, 2=T2, 3=GDM, 4=Other/Secondary | y          |
| dm_date    | dx_date               | Date of diabetes diagnosis. ==**NOTE.** Date of diagnosis is always an estimate, and we may be able to improve it over time. So we want the ability to have multiple entires for this field, rather than over-writing. Can we use careful logging, or is it best to have diagnosis date field as a repeating instrument? If we can keep multiple entries, we would want a variable giving SOURCE of diagnosis - with some categorical options== | dd/mm/yyyy  | —                                    | y          |
| —          | dm_source             | Source of the diagnosis date                                 | categorical | 1=notes, 2=self report, 3=meds       | y          |
| dm_year    |                       |                                                              |             |                                      | [delete]{.highlight} |
| age_dx_y   |                       |                                                              |             |                                      | [delete]{.highlight} |
| age_dx_m   |                       |                                                              |             |                                      | [delete]{.highlight} |
| duration_y |                       | ==We always want each screen to show the CURRENT duration. Perhaps force report generation for an individual ID number?== <br /><br />[So move to report format]{.highlight} |             |                                      | [delete]{.highlight} |
| duration_m |                       |                                                              |             |                                      | [delete]{.highlight} |
| vstatus    | vital_status          | ==Change to auto-generated, using the following logic==<br/><br/>(A) Date of Last Visit - extracted from the date of last patient data collection. <br/>(B) Vital status of patient at this point = ALIVE. <br/>(C) Now we use patient appointment regime. Patient is seen every 6 months, so missing 2 visits = DEFAULT. Patient status then changes to DEFAULT<br/>(D) DEFAULT trips a flag to attempt contact / look for record of death<br/>(E) Death can be confirmed by family or by death record (we must record the source)<br/>(F) If death confirmed, vstatus=DEATH | categorical | 0=Alive, 1=Deceased                  | y          |
|            | date_of_death         | Date of death                                                | dd/mm/yyyy  | —                                    | n          |

## 6. Medications & Self-Management

*Note: medication names, doses, and start/stop dates can be retrieved from PatientSource prescribing records if required for audit or health-economic analysis.*

# St Helena Diabetes Registry

## Final Crosswalk: Data Dictionary ↔ SAP Handbook Metrics

### Legend

- **R** = Required variable
- **D** = Derived from DD variables
- **(Y)** = Used for numerator
- **(D)** = Used for denominator

## Coverage Statement 

> *All metrics specified in the St Helena Diabetes SAP handbook are fully supported by routinely collected PatientSource data, either directly or through transparent derivation. No bespoke data collection is required.*

### Instrument: eligibility_screening

> **Ian to think about this process and complete table** 

This instrument is tied into the screening process a little bit. So a bit for discussion. The current plan is this:

- Auto extract all Dates of Birth / Dates of Diabetes Diagnosis (Ascension = manual entry)
- Calculate Age and Duration of Diabetes
- Flag Eligible / Non-Eligible
- Eligible participants are randomly reordered, then contacted for interest
- **IDEA.** For each new diabetes intervention, create a new instrument
  - Records if a registry punter took part in a particular intervention, along with their eligibility criteria 
  - Once auto-calculated, these eligibility fields are then squirted to the intervention database



Records confirmation of eligibility criteria and cohort classification at study entry for audit and analytic population definition.

| Variable      | Label                                                        | Field type     | Coding                               | Required |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------- | ------------------------------------ | -------- |
| dodiag        | What was the date of diabetes diagnosis                      | YYYY-MM-DD     | –                                    | Y        |
| diab_duration | ***(derived)*** Duration of diabetes                         | text (decimal) | Ideally presented as years and weeks | Y        |
| diab6         | ***(derived)*** Has the potential participant been diagnosed for 6 years or less | yesno          | 0/1                                  | Y        |
| diab10        | ***(derived)*** Has the potential participant been diagnosed for 6 years or less | yesno          | 0/1                                  | Y        |
| height        | Height                                                       | text (decimal) | cm                                   | Y        |
| weight        | Weight                                                       | text (decimal) | kg                                   | Y        |
| bmi           | ***(derived)*** Body Mass Index                              | text (decimal) | kg/m2                                | Y        |
| visit12       | 1 or more visits in the past year                            | text (decimal) | –                                    | Y        |
